text:
maria.mktg: quick ask — we need a validated bench snapshot for the launch post and webinar slide. 200-sample gen-only run, include cold/warm KV, deliver p50/p95/p99 for quantized vs fp16, avg tokens, and a tiny replay bundle. legal needs 5 redacted examples before 5pm.

leo.runtime: can do. which manifest and batching mode? any bucketed percentiles required?

maria.mktg: cohort = "social_mosaic_v1" (200 samples, varied lengths). batching=production. include bucketed p95 for 0-128/129-512/513-1024 and p99. priority HIGH.

tara.dataops: manifest at s3://rdw-marketing/samples/social_mosaic_v1/manifest.json. 6 items marked long (>880) for truncation tests.

viv.engineer: run flags recommended: --model redwood-v2-3b --precision fp16,quantized --warmup 30 --seed 999 --collect_traces --redact true --bucket_percentiles true

benchbot: queued run r-1719991234-01 on staging-dedicated-2

leo.runtime: started run r-1719991234-01. ETA ~20m. will upload summary.csv, samples_redacted.jsonl, replay.tar.gz.

benchbot: run r-1719991234-01 completed. artifacts:
- s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-1719991234-01/summary_bucketed.csv
- s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-1719991234-01/samples_redacted.jsonl
- s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-1719991234-01/replay.tar.gz

viv.engineer: quick pulls: quantized p50 93ms p95 425ms p99 740ms avg_tokens 268; fp16 p50 80ms p95 390ms p99 680ms avg_tokens 271. Long bucket p99 inflated due to 6 truncated items.

maria.mktg: can you paste 5 redacted outputs or point to lines? legal wants to confirm no PII.

leo.runtime: samples_redacted.jsonl contains 5 examples; snippet: {"id":"s-005","out":"Thanks! [REDACTED]...","tokens":42} ... (all redacted)

legal.bot: running quick PII scan on samples_redacted.jsonl. confirm redact pipeline version?

viv.engineer: redact v2.4 used; strips emails/phones/urls. trace ids available for ops.

maria.mktg: draft slide: "p95 under 430ms on production-like social traffic (quantized) — see bucketed tail notes." will include artifact links and parenthetical about truncation. will wait for legal.signoff before PR.

leo.runtime: reproducibility: ./run_bench --manifest manifest.json --run-id r-1719991234-01 --download-artifacts --bucket-percentiles

maria.mktg: thanks team — will add README to webinar assets and open PR after legal OK. :rocket:
